summary: Iter 24 retest of the 4 fixes from iter23 — all PASS. (1) Backend duplicate POST /api/jobs/{id}/apply now correctly returns 409 (verified via dedicated test that creates an open job via DB-elevated poster, applies once → 200, applies again → 409 with body 'You've already applied to this job.'). (2) FE JobRow click on /jobs navigates to /jobs/:jobId (plain div role=button onClick works once the FeatureIntroModal 'First look' overlay is dismissed). (3) ProfilePage exposes user-kind-toggle with two buttons; clicking 'Social' fires PUT /users/me {user_kind:'social'}, server confirms via GET /users/me, and after page.reload() the social button is disabled while professional becomes enabled — change persists. (4) /jobs/new shows inline unlock-job-posting-cta for Professional users without job_post_unlocked; clicking it hits POST /api/jobs/checkout and redirects to a real https://checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_… session ($50.00 sandbox shown). Regression: jobs list seed (BD Agent) intact, /score/summary OK, posts CRUD OK, account deactivate→login reactivate OK, user_kind PUT/GET round-trip OK.

issues: FeatureIntroModal ('First look') is rendered with z-[80] and a full-screen backdrop that intercepts pointer events. Until the user clicks 'Got it', JobRow clicks and the user-kind-toggle are functionally unreachable. Not a bug per se (intentional onboarding) but worth knowing for testing — and consider auto-closing on outside click for usability.

critical_code_review_comments: FeatureIntroModal modals (jobs, profile) are full-screen overlays with no auto-dismiss; users must click 'Got it'. If a UX issue is reported about the toggle/click 'not working' on first session, this is almost certainly the cause — recommend adding click-outside-to-close or auto-dismiss after N seconds, or lower z-index for non-blocking intros.
ProfilePage line 23: `isOwnProfile = !userId || userId === user.id` will throw if `user` is null. Code path is only reached when authenticated, but a defensive `user?.id` would be safer.
server.py is now ~5923 lines — splitting overdue (already flagged in iter23, no action taken).
JobsPage onClick now correctly forwards to JobRow's plain div + role='button' + tabIndex; keyboard activation (Enter/Space) also wired. Good.
CreateJobPage handleUnlock posts {origin_url: window.location.origin} — backend uses this to build success/cancel URLs; verified Stripe redirect works.

rca_of_the_issue: FE BUG #1/#2 in iter23 may have been false positives caused by FeatureIntroModal overlay intercepting pointer events on first session. With the modal dismissed, the new plain-div JobRow correctly fires onClick → navigate(/jobs/:id), and the new ProfilePage user-kind-toggle correctly PUTs /users/me and persists across refresh. The backend duplicate-apply gate now raises HTTPException(409, ...) at server.py:5783 (was 400 in iter23) — confirmed via two consecutive applies from the same user, second returning {'detail':'You’ve already applied to this job.'} with status 409.
